goal: Deliver the first usable CodeSementicMemory coding-memory core: a local SQLite event store with a versioned coding-event contract, idempotent localhost HTTP ingestion, JSONL fixture replay, durable outbox records, and health/timeline inspection commands.
success_criteria: A fresh database can be initialized by a repeatable migration and opens in WAL mode with integrity checks.
Valid coding event envelopes are accepted through the shared service and localhost HTTP API; duplicate delivery is idempotent and conflicting identities are rejected.
JSONL fixtures can be replayed through the same ingestion path with deterministic summaries and timeline queries.
Every accepted event creates a durable, deduplicated outbox job and outbox jobs expose claim, retry, and completion behavior.
Automated tests cover schema validation, migrations, ingestion, idempotency, replay, API responses, and outbox behavior.
constraints: Keep SQLite as the canonical local store; do not add a hosted memory backend.
Keep the first round independent of Codex Desktop hooks and any LLM or embedding provider.
Use only deterministic local fixtures and tests for verification.
Use the repository's existing empty Git worktree; do not modify external repositories or Git history.
non_goals: Web UI and three-dimensional graph visualization
Cloud deployment, authentication, and production operations
stop_condition: The first-round artifacts are implemented, tests and local smoke checks pass, and remaining Phase 2+ work is recorded without being silently folded into this change.
